subject: french
title: Foundations: Places in Town
welcome_lead: Take a walk through la ville and learn the names of every shop and landmark.
meta_desc: GCSE French places in town: boulangerie, poste, gare, cinema, parc and more.
final_note: You're now a tour guide in any French town!

walkthroughs.h2: Le, la and where to shop
walkthroughs.body_html: Most shops are feminine: la boulangerie (bakery), la pâtisserie (cake shop), la boucherie (butcher's), la pharmacie, la poste, la banque. Masculine ones: le supermarché, le marché, le café, le restaurant, le bureau de tabac.

Useful landmarks: la gare (train station), l'aéroport (airport), la mairie (town hall), l'église (church), l'hôpital (hospital). For leisure: le cinéma, le parc, le stade, la piscine (swimming pool), la bibliothèque (library), le musée (museum).

To say to/at the. use:

  • au before masculine: Je vais au cinéma.
  • à la before feminine: Je vais à la boulangerie.
  • à l' before a vowel: Je vais à l'église.
  • aux before plural: Je vais aux magasins.

mcqs.q: Which is correct: 'I'm going to the cinema'?

numericals.q: Read: 'Dans ma ville il y a 2 supermarchés, 3 boulangeries et 1 cinéma.' How many places in total?
